title: Alveolar ridge and keratinized gingiva preservation using collagen matrix and inorganic bone substitute in flapless extractions: A case series of exposed biomaterials De
authors: Souza M, Martinez J, Carvalho V, Novaes A, Mario T. J Int Acad Periodontol. 2022 Oct. 24(4):367- 377.
supports: Clinical study from the botiss mucoderm (porcine collagen soft-tissue matrix) literature list — the product featured in it, which is not the same as the study being about the product, so check the design and the comparator before citing it as product evidence. Authors' conclusion, verbatim: “The ARP limited vertical and horizontal socket changes, regardless of the surgical technique used when the biomaterials where left exposed. The flapless approach seems to provide better results regarding dimensional changes and significantly less discomfort” This records what the paper says, not what a rep may say: the sales wording still has to pass the claim tiers, and a study in one indication licenses nothing in another.
